notes: Binding is coherent (prose AAPL 5m == bound AAPL_5m.pkl, 4680 rows 2026-04-15..2026-07-10) and MACD(12,26,9)/ATR(14) are pinned, but the '2-state Gaussian HMM (using hmmlearn) trained on a rolling window of the last 390 bars' pins neither random seed, covariance type, EM iterations, nor the inference method ('for each bar infer the current hidden state' - Viterbi vs posterior argmax), so the regime signal is stochastic and implementation-dependent. 'Stop distance = ATR(14) * k ... stop orders updated each bar' leaves the stop anchor (entry-price vs trailing high/low) unspecified, and since the long-exit condition equals the short-entry condition, close-only vs stop-and-reverse is unpinned. Sizing is an explicit disjunction ('fixed (e.g., 1 share) or percent-of-equity sizing'). 'other' = nondeterministic ML fit plus the hmmlearn library dependency, which may crash all implementations if absent from the bench environment.
